concerns.text: The plan cites 'Santarabantoosoo/Long_Covid_word_frequency_TFIDF_21_Jul_Oct' as a 'TF-IDF Reference' for term weighting. This is a medical domain dataset (Long Covid) and is inappropriate for software engineering code context. TF-IDF vectors for code must be computed on the code corpus itself (the SWE-bench repository files), not derived from a medical word frequency list. Using this dataset for weighting will introduce semantic noise and invalidate the 'High Fidelity' claim of the TF-IDF strategy.

The plan assumes a '1B-parameter model (e.g., Llama-3-1B)' is available and runnable. As of the current ecosystem, Meta's Llama-3 family starts at 8B parameters; there is no official 1B Llama-3 model. The plan must cite a specific, existing 1B parameter model (e.g., Phi-2, TinyLlama-1.1B, or Qwen-1.5-1.8B) that fits the 7GB RAM constraint with float16/int8 quantization. Assuming a non-existent model variant makes the experimental matrix infeasible.
